Yes — the closest match is [1], which presents a prerequisite-aware location-based recommender system for points of interest, explicitly modeling dependencies where visiting one place presupposes knowledge from others. [1] It also says the system uses an exploration lattice and a structural validity guarantee for next-step recommendations. [1]

If you want a more general urban recommendation approach, [3] recommends walkable itineraries with spatial constraints, and [10] offers neighborhood information retrieval and personalized recommendations, but neither is described as modeling prerequisite knowledge between spots. [3, 10]
